subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

One needs to be free of **__prejudices__** while dealing with judicial cases.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Equalities."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Prejudices"** mean a strong unreasonable feeling of not liking or trusting somebody/something, especially when it is based on his/her/its race, religion or sex. (किस व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के प्रति प्रबल नापसंदगी या अविश्‍वास, विशेषतः उसकी जाति, धर्म या लिंग के कारण; पूर्वाग्रह)

 
 
• **Example**: *Laws against racial **prejudices**__ must be strictly enforced.*
 
 
 
• **"Equalities"** mean the state of being equal, especially in status, rights, and opportunities. (समानता, बराबरी)
 __
 
• **Example**: *We are committed to the ideals of **equalities**__. *
 
 
 
• Therefore, the opposite of **prejudices** is** equalities**.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

- Option 1, Favours: This word means an act of kindness beyond what is due or usual.

- Option 2, Discriminations: This word means the unjust or prejudicial treatment of different categories of people or things, especially on the grounds of race, age, or sex.

- Option 3, Bigotries: This word means intolerance towards those who hold different opinions from oneself.
